findings.summary: E5.5 and E5.6 change no research/ module doc: module_core.md still says Vibe is the sixth runtime and has no Kimi planner arm or Kimi rows, and module_tests.md has none of the 12 new scenarios. The knowledge-base rule and the epic's Definition of Done ask for both, and E5.3 and E5.4 each updated their docs.
findings.fix: Add the Kimi arm (no flags; disk on a Snapshot, none on Scratch; both unconfined and flagged; web unmeasured) and the 7-runtime list to module_core.md. Add the S5.5.x and S5.6.x tests, with their reds or teeth runs, to module_tests.md.

findings.summary: S5.6.7's Then says the row's scratch and coai-vh\<8> are gone after each ending, but the test checks only coai-vh and the person's hash. The coai-question-* scratch holds the copies of the person's code (QuestionRowLaunch.PlaceAsync, then OneShotAsync). No arm checks that it is removed.
findings.fix: In the answered and cancelled arms, take the copy's coai-question-* ancestor from the shim request's --cwd and assert that it no longer exists. In the refused arm, assert that no coai-question-* folder made by this test stays behind.

findings.summary: The junction-first assertions (_unlinked empty) in S5.5.2–S5.5.4 and S5.6.7 were never seen red (deviation 50), and none of these tests proves that a junction was made. If no home were made, each 'recorder never invoked' check would pass without testing anything. The Definition of Done asks for every scenario to be watched red, and E5.4 gave its tests teeth with a temporary break.
findings.fix: Run a teeth check: remove the KimiHome.DisposeAllUnder step from VibeHomes.EmptiedUnderItsLock and from ConsultCheckScratch.KimiHomesDisposed, watch these tests go red, record the messages in the deviations, then revert. Also add a positive check in each test (KimiHome.AfterUnlink fired once for the home's credentials link), so the negative check cannot pass when no home was made.

findings.summary: S5.5.3's Then says the record says cancelled, but the test ignores the reply and also accepts an OperationCanceledException. The check returns a record with state failed and failureKind cancelled (ConsultantCheckTests.cs:471), so 'cancelled' is never asserted.
findings.fix: Await the check without the catch, then assert state 'failed' and failureKind 'cancelled', as ACheckCancelledWhileItsScratchIsMade_IsCancelled_NotUnavailable does.

findings.summary: The new tests name their own temp folders coai-kcheck-data-, coai-kcheck-temp- and coai-qkimi- (AKimiQuestionRowTests.cs:27). Plan §0 and the test-leftovers rule ask for testsToDelete-, and the other Kimi test classes use that prefix.
findings.fix: Use TempDir.For("testsToDelete-kcheck-data-") and similar names for all three folders.

findings.summary: MustCarryNoFlag refuses Flags and Leading but accepts a plan whose AddDirs is not empty. AddDirs holds launch flags too (--add-dir pairs), and decision 3 says ANY flag is refused. The Leading arm (deviation 53) has no test.
findings.fix: Also refuse planned.Plan.AddDirs.Count > 0. Make APlanWithFlags_IsRefusedForKimi a Theory with one case each for Flags, Leading and AddDirs.

findings.summary: The seed's 'why' still names only the first five runtimes' run and the Vibe M-V cells as the cell sources (the plan's anchor :19-20). It does not say that the new kimi rows cite the M-K cells of research/RESULTS_kimi_confinement.md.
findings.fix: Add one clause: the kimi rows cite the M-K cells of research/RESULTS_kimi_confinement.md (Windows, kimi 2.1.1). Then run the runtime-capabilities generator and check that it is current.

findings.summary: The status line says E5.5 and E5.6 were built on Sonnet. §0.2, the plan gate's command, says these stories are built on Opus, and no numbered deviation records the change or who decided it.
findings.fix: Add a numbered deviation that names the model used and who decided it (the operator), or have the fixes made on the model §0.2 names.
